title: PePe Remote Share

status.stoppedHelp: The PePe screen is not available remotely.

runningHelp: Open this address on a PC or phone in the same Tailscale network and enter the PIN.

tailscale.installHelp: Install Tailscale and sign in first.
tailscale.connectionHelp: Start Tailscale and check its network connection.

intro.title: Only the PePe window is shared.
intro.body: The Windows desktop and other applications remain hidden. Connected browsers can control clicks, scrolling, and keyboard input inside PePe.

pin.randomHelp: Generate a new PIN whenever sharing starts
pin.fixedHelp: Always use the same six-digit PIN

mode.label: Transport
mode.webrtcHelp: Low-latency screen streaming. Works on most networks with better quality and responsiveness.
mode.mjpegHelp: Image polling fallback. Use this if WebRTC connections are blocked on your network.

client.loginHelp: Enter the six-digit PIN shown in PePe.
client.endedHelp: Restart sharing in PePe and reconnect.
client.directControl: Touch or click the screen to control
client.touchpadHint:
Move the cursor with one finger
Tap to click
client.invalidPin: The PIN is invalid or sharing has ended.

errors.tailscaleNotInstalled: Tailscale is not installed. Install it and sign in before trying again.
errors.tailscaleDisconnected: Tailscale is installed but disconnected. Start it and connect to the network.
errors.invalidFixedPin: The fixed PIN must contain six digits.
